4. WORKS TO BE C The entire work shall be carried out as under: ARRIED OUT : 1) All the items shall be checked & serviced by the firm at the interval of every 3 month i.e. 4 times in a year. 2) In addition to regular interval check of 3 months, the firm s hall visit & attend the breakdown of RO Plant, within 48 hrs. 3) All Electrical & Electronics Part shall be repaired/ replaced b y the firm, if found defective, during the period of CAMC at his own cost. 4) RO Membrane shall be replaced by the firm, at the time of c ommencement 1st year CAMC & also at the time of comme ncement of 3rd year CAMC, at his own cost. 5) PP filters shall be replaced by the firm, during each quarter ly schedule, at his own cost. 6) Sand Carbon shall be replaced by the firm, during commen cement of each year CAMC schedule, at his own cost. 7) Rota Motor, Pressure Gauge, Pressure Switch etc. shall be r epaired / replaced by the firm, if found defective, at his own cost. 8) In case of High Pressure Pump & Raw Water Pump become defective, the same shall be replaced by the firm on charg eable basis as mentioned in Optional item. 9) If required, Water & Electricity required during execution of CAMC work of RO Plant, will be given by the Railways, free of cost. 10) TDS should be marinated between range 50 to 150 PPM. The contr actor shall be fully responsible for any mishaps, loss, dama ges caused by his staff during the working either to his staff or to Railway property. The Railway reserves all the rights f or recovery of appropriate amount from the bill/ Security D eposit to compensate such losses. 12) All the required tools & equipment for carrying out CAMC s chedule work shall be brought by the firm.

5. TAX: The rates are inclusive of GST. The firm shall have to submit GST Tax Invoice al ong with relevant documents for billing purpose. 6. TRANSPORTATION: The contractor shall arrange for the required transportation to & fro from shed. The contractor is liable to pay any Freight, Far e & Insurance charges for to and fro transportation of materials to/ from Kalva Carshed. 7. COMPLETION PE The contract period for CAMC of RO Plant shall be 3 years from RIOD: the date of execution of work for 1st quarter CAMC of 1st year. The work shall be started i.e. 1st quarter 1st year CAMC within 15 days from the date of issue of letter of acceptance. 8. INSPECTION & A 1) The contractor shall arrange his schedule maintenance visit CCEPTANCE: s on quarterly basis during CAMC period of 3 years. Joint Ins pection Report for the same shall be prepared. In addition, t he contractor shall arrange his staff for breakdown maintena nce as and when required, during the course of the contract period. 2) The CAMC work shall be inspected after each quarterly sche dule for TDS & shall be accepted only after satisfaction by th e Railways. 9. TERMS OF PAYM 1) 100% of CAMC charges shall be made on after 4 quarterly ENT: schedule, to the firm, after successful completion of 4 visits during the quarterly period of CAMC of RO Plant & Final acce ptance by the Railway. 2) If optional item is used during the contract period, the cost of the same will be paid to the firm with 4 quarterly schedule payment mentioned above. 3) The payment shall be made to the firm on submission of bill in triplicate along with Challan, Inspection Report/Work com pletion report. The tenderer can get the payment and r efund of various natures through electronic payment mechanism at all centre where such facilities are avail able in the banks.

10. GUARANTEE/ W The item mentioned in Optional item, if replaced during the co ARRANTY PERIO ntract period of 3 years, the same shall be covered under guar D: antee for a period of 12 months from the date of acceptance b y the Railway. If any failure/defect/deficiencies noticed during Warranty Period, the Contractor has to rectify the same free of cost. All the to and fro transportation charges shall be borne b y the Contractor, if any on Account of guarantee obligation. 11. INDEMNITY BY T You shall have to indemnify and save harmless the Railway fro HE CONTRACTO m and against all actions, suit, proceedings, loses, costs, dama R: ges, charges, claims and demands of every nature and descrip tion brought or recovered against the Railways by reason of an y act or omission of the contractor, his agents or employees, in the execution of the works or in his guarding of the same. In th is connection, you shall have to submit Indemnity Bond on sta mp paper worth Rs.500/- duly notarized. 12. PENALTY: (i) The contractor shall have to execute the quarterly schedul e at an interval of every 90 days (+) 3 working days as grac e period. (ii) If contractor fails to execute quarterly schedule within pres cribed time limit including grace period, a penalty of Rs.500 /- per day will be imposed. 13. RELEASED MAT The materials, released during the execution of above work, sh ERIAL: all be handed over to the Railways by the firm. 14.
